title: Section normalization of the canonical Kan projection isomorphism
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, e:V -> T an etale morphism, M an A-module sheaf on V_et and N an A-module sheaf on T_et. On each W -> V and sections m in M(W), n in N(W -> T), the inverse canonical etaleLowerShriekTensorIso sends the tensor of etaleSumSection(m) and n to etaleSumSection of the tensor of m and etaleLiftSection(n). All section maps are the fixed maps of [def-pur-etale-projection-data]; this identifies the already existing comparison, not an unspecified new isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the forward canonical comparison, which is invertible. Its sheafification tensor comparison sends the tensor of units to the unit of the presheaf tensor, and its sum/sheafification comparison is fixed by the adjunction unit equation. Move these through the Kan-extension unit by naturality. The equation lanUnit_app_comp_lanProjectionMap_app now computes the image as the unit on M tensored with n. The sheafification counit on N cancels its unit.

The inverse restriction comparison equals inverse-image unit followed by graph restriction. Apply its forward comparison and use Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app; naturality moves the graph restriction through it. The site adjunction left triangle identity cancels the resulting unit/counit composite. Substitute this identity in the previous calculation and cancel the forward projection comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleProjection_section_normalization (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {V T : Scheme.{u}} (e : V ⟶ T) [Etale e]
    (M : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (N : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (W : V.Etale)
    (m : M.obj.obj (op W))
    (n : N.obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale e)).obj W))) :
    (etaleLowerShriekTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (inferInstance : Etale e) M N).inv.hom.app
        (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale e)).obj W))
        (etaleSheafTensorSection A _ N
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale e)).obj W)
          (etaleSumSection A e M W m) n) =
      etaleSumSection A e _ W
        (etaleSheafTensorSection A M _ W m (etaleLiftSection A e N W n))
